name: streamwise
description: StreamWise IPTV — a bring-your-own-playlist IPTV application. Monorepo root.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @streamwise/server && npm run build -w @streamwise/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @streamwise/core && npm run typecheck -w @streamwise/server && npm run typecheck -w @streamwise/web && npm run typecheck -w @streamwise/tv-lightning
scripts.test: npm run test -w @streamwise/core && npm run test -w @streamwise/server && npm run test -w @streamwise/tv-lightning
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
